verdict.rationale: Kong's evidence shows it can publish, document, or import OpenAPI specs (Dev Portal, Catalog, decK declarative config) but nothing indicates a spec-first design/authoring workflow that lets a developer create an OpenAPI spec from scratch and export it; kong-docs-9 only lists specs for Kong's own APIs, not a design tool for user APIs. missing for 10: an OpenAPI spec editor/designer, generation of a new spec from scratch, or an explicit 'export OpenAPI' feature for user-authored APIs.
